In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] met with [[Denjax Teppler]] in a '''cantina''' in [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. The [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] was situated on a major thoroughfare close to the [[City/Legends|city's]] main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and received many customers during daylight and evening [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. It catered largely to offworlders.

The cantina's [[Bartender/Legends|bartenders]] had access to a modified [[spray-pattern blaster]] that discouraged any trouble. [[Waiter/Legends|Waiter]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] served customers. Storage and distillery rooms were in the basement immediately below the door. Prior to [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], tours were available of the microdistillery, and after they ceased, the basement was available to be rented out for private parties and [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] recordings.
